title: %dateDiff — difference between two dates in a unit
purpose: Measure the gap from the first date to the second in days, months, or years.
notes: The unit literal must be one of "days", "months", or "years".
The result is the second date minus the first, so b before a yields a negative count.

avoid.why: "weeks" is not a supported unit; only days, months, and years are accepted
